labels.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE applies only to the source-backed isolate susceptibility inputs: four named A. fumigatus isolates have VCZ MIC values in mg/liter, with method based on CLSI M38A and source S03 Table 1. Comparator susceptibility values remain separate; CAS values are minimum effective concentrations. Linked S09 notes supply population totals and a C. albicans truncation warning, but no distribution-bin counts or ECOFF values are supplied. DR01 has drug and comparator support, while workbook identity is not established by this page alone. DR02 and DR03 have source, units and record-level evidence, but record usability remains UNRESOLVED. DR25 and DR26 have isolate identity, susceptibility and limited origin metadata; regimen, exposure, response matching and infection-model details remain UNRESOLVED. DR32 and DR39 have partial distribution context only; coverage, probability construction, freezing and weighted-attainment readiness remain UNRESOLVED. These links indicate partial input support, not satisfied requirements or scientific acceptance.

findings.reason: MI005 remains OPEN and DEFERRED, needed_at adequacy. This page provides isolate susceptibility records and linked notes, but does not establish record-level eligibility for fitting or complete the authorized preparation review. The prior attachment-wide NOT_SEARCHED description is not evidence that other attachment bodies were inspected in this operation.
findings.needed_material: Complete the authorized preparation review in SC014 and provide record-level usability decisions and unresolved findings. Confirm workbook provenance and preserve these records as isolate susceptibility inputs, not animal observations.

findings.reason: A10-A17 and G14-G17 identify four A. fumigatus isolates and their VCZ MICs. A12 states a CLSI M38A-based method. No regimen, free exposure, response endpoint, observation window or matched record-set relationship is supplied. The title alone does not link each isolate to a particular PD record.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported mapping of each relevant isolate MIC to regimen, free-exposure inputs, exposure window and measured response, retaining separate organism and endpoint groups.

findings.reason: The isolate origins in B14-B17 and prior azole exposure in C14-C17 describe isolate context; they do not establish mouse immune state or experimental treatment history. Inoculum, infection site, infection-to-treatment interval, treatment duration, response time, comparator, untreated growth controls, dosing frequency and PK-to-PD correspondence are not supplied. MIC medium, replicates and summary definition are also unspecified.
findings.needed_material: Linked infection-model, dosing-design, response and susceptibility-method records needed to assess index-comparison and target-estimation input coverage. Keep ranking unresolved until design separation and matching are assessed.

findings.reason: MI014 remains OPEN and DEFERRED, needed_at adequacy. A3 supplies Section 3b totals and A4 supplies a truncation warning and a 98% (4149/4237) statement. No MIC-bin counts, complete censored categories or ECOFF body values are supplied; U5 is only a header. The relationship between 4149/4237 and the C. albicans total 13,630 is not established. Defensible probability construction cannot be assessed from these notes alone, and the distributions must not be interpreted as resistance rates.
findings.needed_material: Assess coverage and document defensible probability construction under SC031, or report the limitation preventing distribution-weighted attainment. Review authorized organism-specific bins, units, counts, denominators, censored categories and truncation coverage without silent renormalization.

findings.reason: Only distribution provenance, totals and limitations are available here. Probability construction, weighting definition, MIC-input and distribution-freeze references, and compatible per-MIC PTA products are not supplied. This does not establish a gap in independently assessable per-MIC PTA inputs.
findings.needed_material: Carry MI014 to the weighted-attainment consumer. Before use, supply documented probabilities and coverage limitations, frozen MIC inputs and matching per-MIC PTA products; report weighted attainment separately.

findings.reason: No D14 value is supplied for AZN 8196; absence must not be interpreted as no substitution. C16 explicitly states Unknown, while C14 and C17 state No. F15-F17 and H16 contain >16 values that must remain censored source values. The meaning of the parenthetical (24) in B17 is not supplied.
findings.needed_material: Preserve the missing substitution, explicit Unknown and No values, >16 markers and B17 wording separately. Obtain an authorized source explanation only if interpretation is needed for preparation.
